subject: fre
source: Cambridge IGCSE French – Foreign Language (0520) syllabus for examination in 2025–2027 and 2028–2030 (topic areas A–E and grammar list) — Cambridge International; Year 11 covers topic areas D and E, advanced grammar and exam skills

weeks.topic: Education: school subjects and opinions (parce que, car)
objectives: Describe subjects and timetable
Give and justify opinions using parce que and car

weeks.topic: School life: rules and uniform (il est interdit de, negatives)
objectives: Describe school rules
Use il est interdit de, on doit and negatives ne … rien and ne … personne

weeks.topic: Comparing schools in France and Brazil (le collège, le lycée)
objectives: Compare your school with a French school
Describe a school exchange

weeks.topic: Future plans: further study and training (future tense)
objectives: Describe plans after IGCSE
Form the future tense of regular and irregular verbs

weeks.topic: Jobs and careers (conditional: je voudrais être)
objectives: Name jobs and describe their pros and cons
Use the conditional to express career wishes

weeks.topic: Work experience and part-time jobs (passé composé and imparfait)
objectives: Describe a past work experience
Combine passé composé and imparfait in a narrative

weeks.topic: The workplace: CV, job applications and interviews (formal letter, vous)
objectives: Write a formal application letter
Answer interview questions politely using vous

weeks.topic: Countries, nationalities and languages: learning languages (depuis + present)
objectives: Explain why languages are important
Say how long you have studied using depuis + present

weeks.topic: Culture and customs in Francophone countries: traditions and etiquette
objectives: Describe customs in French-speaking countries
Compare them with Brazilian customs

weeks.topic: Faiths and celebrations: religious and family festivals
objectives: Describe religious festivals and family celebrations
Talk about what you did at a past celebration

weeks.topic: International events: sport, music and travel (passive voice)
objectives: Describe events such as the Tour de France or the Olympics
Use the passive voice a été organisé par

weeks.topic: Global issues: poverty, volunteering and charities (pour que + subjunctive)
objectives: Discuss poverty and volunteering
Use pour que with the present subjunctive

weeks.topic: Town versus country: where I would like to live (si + present, future)
objectives: Compare life in town and in the country
Use si clauses with the present and future

weeks.topic: Tourism and its impact (si + imparfait, conditional)
objectives: Discuss the benefits and problems of tourism
Use si + imparfait with the conditional

weeks.topic: Review: education, work and the international world
objectives: Revise topic areas D and E vocabulary
Practise future and conditional in writing

weeks.topic: Grammar consolidation: plus-que-parfait and passé composé in narratives
objectives: Form the plus-que-parfait
Use it with the passé composé in narratives

weeks.topic: Grammar consolidation: object pronouns y and en and pronoun order
objectives: Use direct and indirect object pronouns
Use y and en and place pronouns correctly

weeks.topic: Grammar consolidation: present subjunctive after il faut que, vouloir que, bien que
objectives: Use the present subjunctive after expressions of necessity, wish and concession
Form common irregular subjunctives

weeks.topic: Listening skills: gist, detail and distractors (Paper 1)
objectives: Identify gist and specific detail
Spot distractors and negatives in recordings

weeks.topic: Reading skills: longer texts and inference (Paper 2)
objectives: Understand longer texts and infer opinions
Answer multiple-choice questions on unseen texts

weeks.topic: Speaking: topic conversation on personal life, school and future (Paper 3)
objectives: Answer open questions with developed responses
Use three time frames in answers

weeks.topic: Speaking: topic conversation on the wider world (Paper 3)
objectives: Give and justify opinions on the environment, technology and international topics
Respond spontaneously to follow-up questions

weeks.topic: Writing: extended piece using a range of tenses and opinions (Paper 4)
objectives: Plan and write a longer piece covering all bullet points
Use varied tenses, connectives and opinions

weeks.topic: Writing accuracy: common errors (agreement, être/avoir auxiliary, accents)
objectives: Identify and correct common errors
Check accents, agreement and auxiliary choice

weeks.topic: Vocabulary consolidation: topic areas A and B high-frequency words
objectives: Revise high-frequency words for everyday activities and personal and social life
Use spaced retrieval and flashcards

weeks.topic: Vocabulary consolidation: topic areas C, D and E high-frequency words
objectives: Revise high-frequency words for the world around us, work and the international world
Learn new 2028 list items such as l'intelligence artificielle and le télétravail

weeks.topic: Mock exams: listening, reading, speaking and writing
objectives: Complete full mock papers in all four skills
Use feedback to build a revision plan

weeks.topic: Review: topic area A — everyday activities
objectives: Revise time, food, health and travel vocabulary
Practise listening tasks

weeks.topic: Review: topic area B — personal and social life
objectives: Revise family, home, clothes and leisure vocabulary
Practise speaking answers

weeks.topic: Review: topic area C — the world around us
objectives: Revise places, environment, technology and town vocabulary
Practise reading tasks

weeks.topic: Review: topic area D — the world of work
objectives: Revise education and work vocabulary
Practise formal writing

weeks.topic: Review: topic area E — the international world
objectives: Revise countries, languages, customs and celebrations
Practise extended writing

weeks.topic: Review: tenses — présent, passé composé, imparfait, futur and conditionnel
objectives: Revise all key tenses and irregular forms
Practise switching between time frames

weeks.topic: IGCSE exams: Paper 3 speaking
objectives: Complete the role plays and topic conversations
Develop answers with opinions and tenses

weeks.topic: IGCSE exams: Paper 1 listening
objectives: Listen for gist and detail across all topic areas
Manage time between recordings

weeks.topic: IGCSE exams: Paper 2 reading
objectives: Answer multiple-choice questions on texts across all topic areas
Use cognates and context to infer meaning

weeks.topic: IGCSE exams: Paper 4 writing
objectives: Write responses covering every bullet point
Check accuracy of tenses and agreement
